scope: Single-user local corpus/documents journeys; ordinary LangGraph + HTTP

implemented.submit_query: Validate original attachment descriptors, snapshot sources; direct, planned or saved-thread continuation
implemented.accept_plan: Revision-checked; one accepted plan resumes the graph checkpoint
implemented.cancel_plan: Cancel pending round; no saved stillborn brief
implemented.edit_plan: Abort the planning round; UI owns editing the question
implemented.change_mode: Replan pending round under same document identity; new revision
implemented.update_task_description: Preserve routing hint while editing description
implemented.add_task: Add user task; planner maxTasks is not a user-edit cap
implemented.toggle_participation: Corpus/documents affect next ask; active source snapshot remains stable
implemented.new_run: Stop active work and clear canvas selection
implemented.open_doc: View-only navigation during work; persisted report and exchanges restore on reopening
implemented.library_search: Stock neural reranking of title + first 400 answer characters; disabled while a run is active
implemented.library_delete: Confined to listed library records; rejected during active writing
implemented.stop: Abort HTTP/graph work, suppress late output, release incomplete document
implemented.pause: Gate asynchronous boundaries; in-flight HTTP may continue
implemented.resume: Release held boundaries; deliberate Hold excluded from inquiry deadline
implemented.wrap_up: Abort ongoing inquiry requests and request reports from completed evidence; then settle
implemented.cancel_agent: Abort selected agent; surviving inquiry findings can still settle
implemented.set_ability_config: Corpus file/directory/glob; documents has no settings. Changes preserve active snapshot
implemented.set_config: Effort and default mode in memory; other changes explicitly rejected

limitations.quit: Closes application session; host process remains owned by launcher
limitations.reload_runtime: Explicit error; use launcher for model residency configuration
limitations.web: Outside current local-source scope; no simulated web evidence
limitations.native_pressure_entropy_perplexity: Unavailable through this HTTP integration; no fabricated values
limitations.image_evidence: HTTP submission recorded separately from native admission/prefill
limitations.tick_level_hold: Not emulated; asynchronous boundary behavior is observable
limitations.native_replay: Raw native traces retained; incumbent uses HTTP and application records, not a native-state replay emulator

content.ingress: Pinned standalone media pipeline receives original bytes
content.inspect: Original PDF, extracted metadata and actual derived image representations by content digest

validation: Contract tests plus shared Fieldnote invariants; real paired journey and quality validation pending
